    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Join" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ViennaNightRun" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Runner" name="Runner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Participate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Run_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunFiveKm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TimeCheck_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TrainAndCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartingNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TravelFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Transport_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RunDrink_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunNightRun</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Drink</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RunDrink_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_App" name="App">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartingBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompareWorkday</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Transport_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FitnessGadget" name="Fitness Gadget">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MeasureTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Participate" name="Want to participate in Vienna Night Run">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Run_Merge" name="Start running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RunFiveKm" name="Run 5 km">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_MeasureTime" name="Measure time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TimeCheck_Split" name="Time under 25 minutes?" default="Flow_07">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_TrainAndCheck" name="Train and check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompareWorkday" name="Compare starting time with end of workday">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Transport_Split" name="More than one hour left?" default="Flow_12">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_TravelFromHome" name="Go there from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Transport_Join" name="Transport chosen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrink_Split" name="Run and drink">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run the Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Drink" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrink_Join" name="Run and drink finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Participate" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Gateway_Run_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Run_Merge" targetRef="Task_RunFiveKm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_RunFiveKm" targetRef="Task_MeasureTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_MeasureTime" targetRef="Gateway_TimeCheck_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Under 25 minutes" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>time under 25 minutes</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Not achieved" sourceRef="Gateway_TimeCheck_Split" targetRef="Task_TrainAndCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_TrainAndCheck" targetRef="Gateway_Run_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CompareWorkday"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CompareWorkday" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="More than one hour" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Split" targetRef="Task_TravelFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>more than one hour left between starting time and end of workday</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Split" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_TravelFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_Transport_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Transport_Join" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Split" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Split" targetRef="Task_Drink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_Drink" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrink_Join" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTimeReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
